programme.title: Brahms' Curse: The Boy 2
programme.desc: Kun uusi perhe muuttaa Heelshiren kartanoon, ei kestä kauaakaan, kun heidän nuorin poikansa ystävystyy elävän oloisen nuken kanssa. Elokuva on jatko-osa vuoden 2016 kauhuelokuvahitille The Boy. Pääosassa loistaa Katie Holmes.

programme.title: Movie 43
programme.desc: Sulje silmät ja peitä korvat! Sekaisin Marista- ja Nuija ja tosinuija -elokuvista tuttu Peter Farrelly on kerännyt mielettömän näyttelijäkaartin elokuvaan, jossa mikään ei ole pyhää.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Majava
programme.desc: Majavasta voi olla apua sinullekin! Walter Blackin huumori on yhtä mustaa kuin hänen sukunimensä. Töissä menee huonosti, vaimo on saanut tarpeekseen ja poika vihaa isäänsä.

programme.title: Paluu Yorkshireen
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison (Jim Broadbent) saa tietää, että hänellä on syöpä ja vain muutama viikko aikaa elää. Hänen vanhin poikansa Blake (Oscar-voittaja* Colin Firth) muuttaa Yorkshireen äitinsä luokse, kylään jossa hän syntyi. Kun Arthurin tila heikkenee, Blake puntaroi suhdettaan isäänsä.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Nuori pari Simon (Bateman) ja Robyn (Hall) törmäävät sattumalta kaupassa Simonin vanhaan ja miltei unohdettuun tuttavaan, erikoislaatuiseen Gordoon (Edgerton).

programme.title: Toivon lähteet
programme.desc: Oltuaan 30 vuotta naimisissa keski-ikäinen pariskunta ryhtyy intensiiviseen viikon kestävään pariterapiaan työstääkseen parisuhdettaan.

programme.title: About Fate
programme.desc: Tämä romanttinen komedia on kertomus kahdesta ihmisestä, jotka uskovat rakkauteen, mutta eivät tunnu löytävän sitä. Villien käänteiden jälkeen kohtalo saattaa heidän polkunsa kohtaamaan myrskyisenä uudenvuodenaattona. Siitä seuraa komediaa ja kaaosta.

programme.title: To Rome With Love
programme.desc: To Rome With Love on yhteen maailman hurmaavimmista kaupungeista sijoittuva kaleidoskooppinen komedia, jota tähdittävät mm. Alec Baldwin ja Penélope Cruz sekä elokuvan ohjaaja Woody Allen. Tutustumme mm.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton on nuori ja komea mutta rahaton tennisvalmentaja, joka sotkeutuu rikkaan perheen kuvioihin ryhdyttyään perheen tyttären valmentajaksi. Rakkaussuhteet kahden eri naisen kanssa pakottavat hänet julmaan rikokseen. Intohimoa, kiusauksia ja mielettömyyttä yläluokan Lontoossa.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: Danielin ja Robertin isän kuolema saattaa toraisan perheen yhteen suremaan vainajaa. Kun hautajaisiin ilmestyvä mies uhkaa paljastaa vainajan järkyttävän salaisuuden ellei saa rahaa, on veljesten keksittävä jotain päästäkseen kiristäjästä eroon.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Vuosi on 1985. Pastellivärien, puutelihiusten ja otsanauhojen aikakautena nuori Janey uneksii tanssijan urasta. Koulua hän on ehtinyt vaihtaa jo 11 kertaa, ja hän tietää että ne eivät muutu miksikään.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: Sin-Dee Rella on palannut kaduille oltuaan 28 päivää vankilassa. Hän on transnainen ja prostituoitu ja tapaa ystävänsä ja kollegansa Alexandran, joka kertoo hänelle, että Sin-Deen parittajapoikaystävällä oli suhde hänen poissa ollessaan.

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: Päällepäin ympäristökonsultti Adamilla, yksityisyrittäjä Mikellä ja ensiapulääkäri Neilillä ei ole mitään yhteistä, mutta he kaikki ovat mukana 12 askeleen ohjelmassa kohti vapautta riippuvuuksistaan.

programme.title: Awake
programme.desc: Mies herää sairaalassa, eikä hänellä ole muistikuvaa siitä, kuka hän on. Pian selviää, että häntä etsitään murhasarjasta epäiltynä.

programme.title: Kuutio
programme.desc: Seitsemän toisilleen ventovierasta henkilöä, joilla kaikilla on erilaiset persoonat, asetetaan vasten tahtoaan loputtomaan sokkeloon, joka on täynnä hengenvaarallisia ansoja.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: Viides Valta
programme.desc: He perustivat vallanpitäjiä hätyyttävän nettisivun ja heistä tuli maailman jahdatuimpia ihmisiä. WikiLeaksin perustajat Julian Assange ja Daniel Domscheit-Berg saivat haltuunsa kaikkien aikojen suurimman määrän luottamuksellisia ja vuodettuja tietoja Yhdysvaltain puolustusministeriöstä.

programme.title: Autumn in New York
programme.desc: Will Keane on viittäkymppiä lähestyvä menestyvä newyorkilainen ravintoloitsija ja parantumaton naistenmies. Mies purjehtii suhteesta toiseen - kunnes hän kohtaa nuoren Charlotten. Vielä kokematon Charlotte on sulaa vahaa maailmanmiehen käsittelyssä, mutta romanssi saa tylyn lopun.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Vietettyään kuusi vuotta sotavankeudessa sisällissodan aikana ystävällinen etelävaltiolaissotilas palaa tilalleen ja tapaa vaimonsa, joka on luullut hänen kuolleen. Pettynyt kosija paljastaa sotilaan huijariksi, ja että oikeaa Sommersbya syytetään murhasta.

programme.title: Paluu Yorkshireen
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison (Jim Broadbent) saa tietää, että hänellä on syöpä ja vain muutama viikko aikaa elää. Hänen vanhin poikansa Blake (Oscar-voittaja* Colin Firth) muuttaa Yorkshireen äitinsä luokse, kylään jossa hän syntyi. Kun Arthurin tila heikkenee, Blake puntaroi suhdettaan isäänsä.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.
Nuoren kirjailijan on hyväksyttävä kuolevaisuutensa kun hänellä todetaan harvinainen syöpä.Parhaan ystävänsä ja empaattisen nuoren terapeutin avulla hän löytää rohkeuden taistella sairautta vastaan.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva Mad Money seuraa kolmea erilaista naista, jotka ovat töissä Yhdysvaltain keskuspankissa. He muodostavat tuhoon tuomitun liiton varastaakseen pankista rahaa.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Nuori Therese Belivet (Rooney Mara) työskentelee tavaratalossa 1950-luvun alun Manhattanilla ja unelmoi täydemmästä elämästä. Hän tapaa Carol Airdin (Cate Blanchett), viehättävän kypsän naisen, joka on loukussa murenevassa kulissiavioliitossa.

programme.title: The Dreamers
programme.desc: Kolme elokuvantuntijaa, amerikkalainen vaihto-opiskelija Matthew sekä kaksoset Théo ja Isabelle ovat tulleet läheisiksi yhteisen kiinnostuksen kohteensa vuoksi. Théon ja Isabellen epätavallinen intiimi yhteys kiehtoo Matthew’ta.

programme.title: Kuutio

programme.title: Bullet To The Head
programme.desc: Yksi elokuvahistorian suurimmista toimintasankareista on taas täällä: Sylvester Stallone esittää kivikovaa, New Orleansissa asuvaa palkkamurhaajaa.

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: Don Martellin siloinen elämä pyörii perheen, kavereiden ja punttitreenin ympärillä, minkä lisäksi hän käy uskollisesti kirkossa joka pyhä. Kavereidensa ”Don Joniksi” ristimä hurmuri iskee baarista pelkkiä täydellisiä naisia, joista kukaan ei kuitenkaan vedä vertoja pornolle.

programme.desc: A transient man tries to resist the officers in booking then serenades them with a song. A difficult inmate blames his behavior on various medical conditions, and a woman claims to be Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A man is arrested at a popular theme park for public intoxication. A detainee swallows his earring during processing. Officers attempt to restrain a combative woman in custody.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A man attempts to eat marijuana in jail. The Special Detention Unit investigates forbidden letters hidden amongst inmates. A bloody, vicious brawl escalates between an imprisoned duo.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In San Diego, CA an officer grapples with a combative detainee. In Portland, OR six party goers are taken into custody. In Fort Worth, TX a high-risk inmate manages to get the key to his handcuffs.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In Portland, OR a man in custody accuses officers of being involved in the 1992 event at Ruby Ridge. In Sarasota, FL a drunk man falls off his bike and purports to have been hit by a car. In Las Vegas, LV a daring inmate attempts to make a break for it while the supervising officers attend to a disturbance.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In Salt Lake City, UT a man is sent to a holding cell after hurling racial insults. In Reno, NV A man outfitted in just his underwear is taken into custody for battery of a police officer. In Portland, OR an intoxicated eldery man breaks into song during booking.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Boisterous inmates are placed in restraints after initiating several verbal altercations. A woman struggles with substance abuse following the death of her fianc̩, and two young escorts discuss their observing strategy when casino hopping.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Headbutts and aggression abound during a jail fight. A young man is arrested after stealing $1,500 worth of hats. Officers discover a suicidal inmate who’s no longer taking his medication.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: After refusing a breathalyzer test, an irate man bangs his head against plexiglass. A man transforms into a “cell warrior” within his holding pen. Soon to be released, an inmate considers the future.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A combative man is placed in a side cell. A transgender woman shares her story. A wild driver is placed in custody, and an intoxicated man is arrested for assault.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An inmate claims to be the victim of an internet scam which led to his arrest. Officers take it easy on a rowdy inmate struggling through a spiritual crisis. Years of prison time can’t sway a young gang affiliate from changing his ways. Prisoners cause plumbing problems to send a message. A mother and daughter bond over being locked up together.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A jail chaplain counsels a sad inmate. An intoxicated woman demands to talk to the Canadian Embassy.

programme.title: MacGruber
programme.desc: Maailmanrauha on vaarassa, terroristit vaanivat, maailma tarvitsee supersankarin, jolla on tukka kuin Hillary Clintonilla. Kenelle pitää soittaa? MacGruberille!

programme.title: Amateur Night
programme.desc: Jason Biggs esittää Guyta, palkittua, vasta valmistunutta arkkitehtia. Nyt hän on kuitenkin työtön, tuleva isä, joka etsii epätoivoisesti töitä. Vaimonsa vaatimuksesta Guy vastaa netti-ilmoitukseen, jossa etsitään ”kuljettajaa”.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: The Funeral Party
programme.desc: Felix Bush haluaa suunnitella omat hautajaisensa ja pyytää apuja järjestelyihin paikalliselta hautausurakoitsijalta Frank Quinnilta. Paikalla tulee olla jokaisen, jolla on kerrottavanaan tarina hänestä. Tärkeintä on, että riennoissa on mukana myös päivänsankari itse – elävänä.

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat 2
programme.desc: Menestyksekäs laulukolmikko, pikkuoravat Alvin, Simo ja Tero, ovat palanneet ratkiriemukkaassa jatko-osassa, jossa on enemmän musiikkia, keppostelua ja hauskanpitoa – sekä kauniit ja lahjakkaat tyttöoravat.Ovatko pojat kohdanneet vertaisensa?

programme.title: My Old Lady
programme.desc: New Yorkissa asuva tyhjätasku Mathias perii pariisilaisasunnon isältään, jota hän ei koskaan tuntenut. Uudessa kiinteistössä Mathiasta odottaa kuitenkin yllätys vanhahkon, sivistyneen rouva Mathilden ja hänen suojelevaisen tyttärensä asuttaessa asuntoa.

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: Rantakaupunkilomallaan 14-vuotias Duncan vieraantuu äidistään, joka pyrkii päättäväisesti saamaanuuden parisuhteensa toimimaan.

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Tyytymätön vaimonsa kuolemaan, englanninopettaja masentuu ja katkeroituu, mutta löytää silti mahdollisuuden uuteen rakkauteen.

programme.title: Driven
programme.desc: On 80-luvun alku Kaliforniassa. Seuraamme John DeLoreanin ja hänen autoyhtiönsä rakettimaista nousua uuden ystävän, Jim Hoffmanin kautta. Tämä on entisten rötöstensä takia FBI:n ilmiantaja.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva Mad Money seuraa kolmea erilaista naista, jotka ovat töissä Yhdysvaltain keskuspankissa. He muodostavat tuhoon tuomitun liiton varastaakseen pankista rahaa.

programme.title: Break Point
programme.desc: Darren on rahapulassa ja Jimmy haluaa tehdä paluun tennismaailman huipulle. Siispä he päättävät lyöttäytyä yhteen, perustaa uudelleen nuoruutensa nelinpeliparin ja pyrkiä Grand Slam -turnaukseen karsintojen kautta.

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: Aloitteleva muotisuunnittelija kamppailee menestyksen ja rakkauden löytämiseksi. Tarina sijoittuu hänen elämäänsä kerran vuodessa, aina samana päivänä: hänen syntymäpäivänään.

programme.title: Amateur Night

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Tervetuloa Westburgin lukioon jossa halitsee kolme kauneuskuningatarta, Heather C, Heather M ja Heather D. Heillä on valta, ulkonäkö ja rahat tehdäkseen mitä he haluavat.

programme.title: Good Kids
programme.desc: GOOD KIDS seuraa neljän juuri lukionsa huippuarvosanoin päättäneen nuoren kesää Cape Codin pikkukaupungissa.

programme.title: Nurse Betty
programme.desc: Betty katsoo uskollisesti lempisaippuasarjaansa “Syy rakastaa. Törmättyään kahteen ammattitappajaan katsoessaan yhtä sarjan jaksoa Betty muuttuu “Nurse Bettyksi ja lähtee etsimään sydämensä valittua, tohtori David Ravellia.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards on onneton nuori mies, joka kärsii vastakaiuttomasta rakkaudesta ja haluaa epätoivoisesti muuttaa elämänsä. Hän solmii sopimuksen paholaisen kanssa, ja tämä lupaa toteuttaa hänen toiveensa – mutta sillä on hintansa.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone on Long Islandin paras lennonjohtaja, kunnes hiljainen muukalainen, Russell Bell, siirretään hänen osastolleen. Näiden New York TRACONin kahden huippulennonjohtajan välinen kilvoittelu eskaloituu mahdollisesti vaaralliselle tasolle.

programme.title: The Wedding Guest
programme.desc: Sarja huvittavia ja onnettomia kohtauksia vain vahvistaa, että hän on rakastuneempi kuin koskaan.

programme.title: Marmaduke

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael!

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s Dustbowl. Enjoy the singing cowboy in his first starring role, rubbing shoulder with politians, going up against greedy executives, and representing a whole people group you'll see why Rogers became a national icon! Frog Millhouse: Smiley Burnett. Elanore Fairbanks: Carol Hughes. John Fairbanks: Guy Usher. Plus music and singing from the Maple City Four. (The song Dust was nominated for an Academy Award!) Directed by Joe Kane.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: Location shooting in the Florida Everglades add to this dramatic tale of five Confederate deserters trying to get to Cuba. First, they must overcome snake bites, unfriendly Seminoles, and their own conflicts with each other. How many of the five will actually make it out alive? Lin McCarthy, Stephen Courtleigh, and Berry Kroeger star in this little known example of 1950s independent filmmaking.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An unholy alliance! Marking the feature film debut of one of Hollywoods most influential and widely referenced auteur directors, Sam Peckinpah, The Deadly Companions centers on a redemptive journey to escort a funeral procession through dangerous Indian Territory. Featuring fine work from a top-notch cast that includes the inimitable Maureen OHara at the height of her illustrious career, Peckinpahs first foray into film provides a promising glance into the energetic and violent nature of his iconic later works.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex!

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country And western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Celebrate 25 years of The Crazy Bull with a high-octane compilation of El Toro Loco’s most legendary moments. programme.title: BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal 2026
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.

programme.title: Searching For Clues

Chief Abe’s children, Frank and Sandra, return home upon hearing that their father is suffering from an incurable disease and his days are numbered, but when Chief Abe is murdered, they become prime suspect in the police investigation. Are they the most likely culprits to this crime?

programme.title: All I Ask
programme.desc: Mrs Eugene goes from thinking she is in a happy marriage to finding out her husband is having an affair, while battling life-threatning illness. Will she put her family back together on time?

programme.title: Love Gone Mad
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Tomike is a kind and loving woman who tries to please everyone. She has been with her boyfriend, Ayomide, for several years with promises of marriage that doesn’t happen. Ayomide takes advantage of Tomike’s kindness, including manipulating her into abortions, claiming he is not ready to be a father; however Tomike finally snaps when she finds out he is the father to another woman’s child.

programme.title: The Love I Prayed For
programme.desc: When kind-hearted Ella gets a new job as the housekeeper to a man with an unfaithful girlfriend, she takes it upon herself to help him with his broken heart but where will that leave her own relationship?

programme.title: All Shades Of Amanda
programme.desc: Love finds a young girl who dwells in the captivity of her past heartbreak but she tries to fight it.

programme.title: A Little Like Happiness
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Jude, a bus driver, and Monica, a lawyer, meet when Jude cusses Monica over change from a fare. Their meeting turns into an unlikely friendship as Monica begins to advise Jude on improving his life.

programme.title: Billionaire Husband or Nothing
programme.desc: Evelyn must do all she can to find out why she sabotages her happiness just when she is about to get her happily ever after.

programme.title: Love Found Me
programme.desc: The fate of a young woman in a toxic relationship changes after a chance meeting caused by car trouble.

programme.title: Humble Pie
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A down-on-their luck couple turn to a life of crime, calling themselves Bonnie and Clyde, when the man loses his job due to unfortunate circumstances. Their crimes lead them to a bickering couple, Eric and Zara, and this chance meeting has everyone re-evaluating their actions.

programme.title: AMC Red Carpet - The Oxymoron of Kennyblaq 6.0
programme.desc: AMC Red Carpet moments brings you exclusive red carpet interviews with Nollywood stars at the premieres of top Nollywood movies and other industry events such as award ceremonies.

programme.title: Love Trap
programme.desc: When down-on-her-luck Sophia goes to her friend for help, she is introduced to a lifestyle that gets her into trouble with the authorities causing her to find ways to change her fate.

programme.title: A Wish For Hell
programme.desc: A newly married couple are facing a crisis in their marriage as the wife feels unfufilled and the husband is hiding a big secret that will change everything.

programme.title: Again
programme.desc: Willing to give their love another chance, Nifemi and Seun work towards repairing a damaged marriage that just may never recover.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Rival twin sisters compete against each other for recognition because one of them has always felt left out and segregated by friends and their family and now she must fight to prove a point that she is as equally important as her twin.

programme.title: Kill Fred
programme.desc: Out for revenge, Rose, plots to kill her husband, Fred, with the help of her lover, Vic, not realising Vic has his own reasons for wanting Fred dead.

programme.title: Lurikos
programme.desc: Terminally-ill Michael believes he has found new love with Serena after his wife is killed in a car accident. However, things are complicated when he finds out Serena is promised to another, but will true love find a way through all these challenges?

programme.title: Digging Deep
programme.desc: A group of young women facing very different challenges in their relationships, from infidelity to negligence, try to help each other out with their problems but things do not go as planned.

programme.title: In The Pursuit of Love
programme.desc: In his quest to find true love, a young CEO decides to disguise himself and hide his true identity. He meets a female who challenges his whole idea of love and hustle. Will this be his final bus stop?

programme.title: Anger Of Death
programme.desc: A priest, known for his outspokenness, is faced with the challenge of standing up for his people through his prominent position.

programme.title: His Mystery Lover
programme.desc: Bryan's indecision between two women costs him true love, leaving him unable to commit and ultimately missing out on a genuine connection.

programme.title: Rhythm And Love
programme.desc: Tensions between two tenants, a budding musician and a social media influencer, continues to rise as they try to find a way to co-exist in each other's space.

programme.title: The Weekend
programme.desc: A woman discovers a heart-breaking secret. She plans a steamy intimate weekend with her husband, but this weekend is full of questions, anger, rage and blood. She will not stop until she gets her answers.

programme.title: In Bloom - Period
programme.desc: A collection of 5 short films addressing gender equality issues such as period poverty, child marriage, gender-based violence, HIV and economic empowerment. First Short: Period - written and directed by Nicole Teeny (USA). Like many of her classmates at her underserved school, Fay cannot afford menstrual products, so she sets out on a crusade to get them for free.

programme.title: Stood Up
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. On the day of her wedding to Patrick, Roselyn receives a message from him telling her that he would not be showing up as he can no longer marry her. Heartbroken, she reluctantly rekindles her relationship with Walter, her ex boyfriend, who she broke up with because of his cult ties. Walter convinces Roselyn he is no longer in a cult, and they soon make plans to marry, however the unexpected happens a night to their wedding.

programme.title: Grim
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Charles loses his job shortly after settling down with his wife, Abigail. Things become pretty difficult for the family as Abigail is a fresh graduate and yet to secure a job, as a result, she cannot help financially. They decide to hold off on having children, however, Abigail gets pregnant and they cannot agree on how to handle it. The situations not helped by the unexpected arrival of Charles' mother, Evelyn.

programme.title: Do Not Marry
programme.desc: Lekan tries to put Peter off getting married because he wants to continue to live off Peter free of charge. He hires a hooker, Simi, as a way to get Peter’s mind off the marriage train but his plan backfires when Simi discovers Lekan’s true motives.

programme.title: Business Men
programme.desc: In a bid to make some extra cash and impress the family of his beloved, David unknowingly gets involved with some nefarious characters leading up to a major police investigation.

programme.title: Public Yard
programme.desc: Following the lives of a group of young people living in a face-me-I-face-you estate. Toke is constantly putting pressure on Femi for a better life, from him getting a better job, to having children and even for him to stop flirting with his friend, Chioma.

programme.title: Bennie
programme.desc: Bennie, a mother of three, knows her time is near after months of keeping her ovarian cancer a secret. To test her husband’s ability to take care of their children when she’s gone, she disappears without a trace, leaving him alone to cater for the children.

programme.title: The Guy Next Door
programme.desc: After Leo loses his job, he and his wife, Annie, turn the unwanted obsession of their next-door neighbour, Timothy, who refuses to accept rejection, into a risky source of income.

programme.title: Shaffy's Sister
programme.desc: Shaffy’s sister, Daisy, struggles to interact with her family and find her place in society after spending years in prison.

programme.title: Boheemielämää
programme.desc: Boheemielämää kertoo kolmen taiteilijan tarinan. Kirjailija Marcel Marxin, taidemaalari Rodolfon ja säveltäjä Shaunardin, rakkauksien, töiden ja ainaisen rahapulan värittämään taiteilijaelämään pureutuva elokuva perustuu Henri Murgerin kuuluisaan samannimiseen romaaniin vuodelta 1851.

programme.title: Broken Hill Blues
programme.desc: Joukko pienen pohjoisruotsalaisen kaivospaikkakunnan nuoria on aloittamassa taistelua itsensä ja ympäröivän maailman kanssa, kun maa heidän allaan alkaa kirjaimellisesti järkkyä.

programme.title: Linan yökirja
programme.desc: Liina Berglund on täysin tavallinen 15 - vuotias tyttö, joka haluaisi olla samanlainen kuin hänen huolettomat ja suositut ystävänsä. Liina on kyllästynyt olemaan näkymätön ja sellainen reppana, joka ei koskaan ole edes suudellut.

programme.title: Helsinki-Napoli All Night Long
programme.desc: Suomalainen Alex ajaa taksia Berliinin kolkoilla kaduilla. Ilta vaikuttaa alkavan kuten mikä tahansa muukin, vaimon heittäminen töihin, Igorin kanssa asioiden hoitelua, mutta sitten kyytiin hyppää kaksi hämärämiestä suuren rahalaukun kanssa, takaa-ajajat kintereillään!

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Lindell: Unenvartija - Osa 2
programme.desc: Unenvartija on sietämättömän jännittävä rikostarina, jossa psykologiset pohjasävyt kuljettavat tapahtumia eteenpäin, kunnes kaikki päättyy dramaattiseen kilpajuoksuun häikäilemättömän murhaajan kanssa.

programme.title: Lindell - Käärmeenkantaja - Del 2
programme.desc: Ensi hetkestä alkaen Käärmeenkantaja pitää katsojan otteessaan tässä järkyttävässä psykologisessa draamassa, jossa hulluuden logiikka ajaa tapahtumia kohti väistämätöntä kliimaksia. Sarjamurhaaja kulkee vapaana Oslossa.

programme.title: Historiaa Tehdään Öisin
programme.desc: Harry on CIA-agentti, joka toimii peitetehtävissä helsinkiläisen Moving Planet -jazzklubin omistajana. Nuori SVR-agentti Natasha asuu myös Helsingissä – hänen tehtävänä on vakoilla Harrya.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Lääketieteen opiskelijat ja ohjelmoijat Julia ja Rebecca kuuluvat Lundin yliopiston eliittiryhmään, joka tutkii kiistanalaista tieteellistä menetelmää biohakkerointia, geenitekniikan uutta toivoa, joka saattaa merkitä tappavien sairauksien loppua.

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Juha (Sakari Kuosmanen, Kauas pilvet karkaavat) ja Marja (Kati Outinen, Sauna) elävät yhdessä onnellisina ja viattomina kuin lapset kunnes käärme luikertelee paratiisiin Shemeikan (André Wilms, Boheemielämää) hahmossa. Juha perustuu Juhani Ahon kuuluisaan romaaniin.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Bitchkram
programme.desc: Kristin laskee päiviä ylioppilaskirjoituksiin, jolloin hän voi jättää pikkukaupungin ja manipuloivan sisarensa unelmiensa New Yorkia varten. Kaikki sujuu täydellisesti, ja paikallislehti julkaisee hänen kolumnejaan.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Hamlet liikemaailmassa
programme.desc: Maailmankirjallisuuden tunnetuin sukudraama on siiretty nykysuomen liike-elämän vallan linnakkeisiin, keskelle Helsingin rock´n rollin tahdissa sykkivää betoniviidakkoa.

programme.title: Hella W
programme.desc: Sankarittaren elämä. Hella Wuolijoen elämä ja työ. Runoilija, vakooja ja miljonääri, josta tuli kansainvälisesti tunnettu liikenainen, poliitikko ja näytelmäkirjailija, joka teki yhteistyötä Euroopan johtavien kirjailijoiden, kuten Bertolt Brechtin ja Maksim Gorkin.

programme.title: Winnerbäck
programme.desc: Lars Winnerbäck on lukeutunut Ruotsin suurimpiin artisteihin jo 15 vuotta, ja kuitenkin hän on se, josta tiedetään vähiten. Nyt tuskin 40 täyttänyt Winnerbäck viettää 20. taiteilijavuottaan.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush perustuu Bill Keenanin humoristiseen muistelmateokseen, josta tuli jymymenestys. Harvardin lätkäjoukkueen Bobby Sanders siirtyy pelaamaan Ruotsin alemmille sarjatasoille diilissä, johon liittyy mm. laadukas pesukone.

programme.title: Laitakaupungin valot
programme.desc: Laitakaupungin valot kertoo yövartijana työskentelevästä Koistisesta, joka joutuu petoksen uhriksi. Laitakaupungin valot oli mukana vuoden 2006 Cannesin elokuvajuhlien kansainvälisessä kilpasarjassa. Elokuva palkittiin parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnolla vuonna 2007.

programme.title: Broken Hill Blues
programme.desc: Joukko pienen pohjoisruotsalaisen kaivospaikkakunnan nuoria on aloittamassa taistelua itsensä ja ympäröivän maailman kanssa, kun maa heidän allaan alkaa kirjaimellisesti järkkyä.

programme.title: Tulitikkutehtaan tyttö
programme.desc: Äitinsä ja isäpuolensa kanssa asuva ja tulitikkutehtaan liukuhihnalla työskentelevä Iiris (Kati Outinen, Mies vailla menneisyyttä ja Le Havre) erehtyy luulemaan tanssiravintolassa kohtaamansa miehen kanssa viettämäänsä yötä rakkaudeksi. Väärinkäsityksellä on kohtalokkaat seuraukset.

programme.title: Historiaa Tehdään Öisin
programme.desc: Harry on CIA-agentti, joka toimii peitetehtävissä helsinkiläisen Moving Planet -jazzklubin omistajana. Nuori SVR-agentti Natasha asuu myös Helsingissä – hänen tehtävänä on vakoilla Harrya.

programme.title: Akvaariorakkaus
programme.desc: Anna-Leena Härkösen menestysromaaniin perustuva elokuva itseään etsivästä Saarasta ja Jonista (Nicke Lignell), joka yrittää tehdä kaikkensa auttaakseen Saaraa, mutta tehtävä osoittautuu mahdottomaksi.

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Viikkoa ennen joulua laskeutuu Estelle Svensson Tukholman Arlandaan. Vuotta aiemmin joutui hän pakenemaan tyttärensä ja aviomiehensä Tommyn kanssa ulkomaille, kun aviomies oli suunnitellut ja toteuttanut Ruotsin rikoshistorian kaikkien aikojen suurimman pankkiryöstön.

programme.title: White People
programme.desc: Alex (Vera Vitali) siepataan kadulla ruokakaupan edessä ja hänet viedään maanalaisiin tiloihin, joissa ihmiset odottavat vangittuina karkotustaan. Viktoria (Pernilla August, “Tähtien Sota: Episodi I – Pimeä uhka”) on operaation pomo, joka hallitsee miehistöään rautaisin ottein.

programme.title: Varjoja paratiisissa
programme.desc: Varjoja paratiisissa kertoo roskakuskin ja supermarketin kassan rakkaustarinan. Se kertoo ihmisistä kadun varjoisalla puolella, mutta myös itsekunnioituksesta ja rakkauden välttämättömyydestä.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Hamlet liikemaailmassa
programme.desc: Maailmankirjallisuuden tunnetuin sukudraama on siiretty nykysuomen liike-elämän vallan linnakkeisiin, keskelle Helsingin rock´n rollin tahdissa sykkivää betoniviidakkoa.

programme.title: Helsinki-Napoli All Night Long
programme.desc: Suomalainen Alex ajaa taksia Berliinin kolkoilla kaduilla. Ilta vaikuttaa alkavan kuten mikä tahansa muukin, vaimon heittäminen töihin, Igorin kanssa asioiden hoitelua, mutta sitten kyytiin hyppää kaksi hämärämiestä suuren rahalaukun kanssa, takaa-ajajat kintereillään!

programme.title: Total Balalaika Show
programme.desc: Toinen maailmansota päättyi lopullisesti vasta kesäkuussa 1993 kun Leningrad Cowboys ja Puna-armeijan kuoro esiintyivät yhdessä Helsingin Senaatintorilla järjestetyssä konsertissa 70 000 katsojan edessä.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Attack Angels
programme.desc: Edward Tustin, head of a group trying to take over Western Techtronics, engages efficiency expert, Dr. John Reardon of Executive Assistants, to have the four members of Techtronics who oppose his takeover killed.

programme.title: Angel On A Roll
programme.desc: After twelve different banks have been robbed of a quarter of a million dollars in hundred dollar bills, the Angels are called in to investigate.

programme.title: Mr. Galaxy
programme.desc: Ron Gates, a young body builder, has several accidents while training with his manager, Artie Weaver, for the Mr. Galaxy title. The Angels are called in to find out who is trying to injure Ron.

programme.title: He Married An Angel
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Barbara Stone and her sister, Jane, to track down John Thornwood. He has swindled them out of $100,000 by promising to marry Jane and persuading her to invest money in a phony South American oil exploration venture.

programme.title: Taxi Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are called in to investigate, when Tom Archer, who owns a cab company with his wife Laurie, is badly burned as his cab explodes. Laurie Archer reveals that they have been getting threatening phone calls and someone obviously is trying to put them out of business.

programme.title: Let Our Angel Live
programme.desc: The Angels and Bosley are hired to track down Joe Danworth, who walked off with $200,000 of his employer's money. Kelly and Bosley are waiting in their cars outside of his apartment building when he shows up.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels (Pilot)
programme.desc: Three sexy police-trained detectives work for an unseen boss named, Charlie, who always relays his assignments by telephone.

programme.title: Hellride
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels, three bright, beautiful, athletic and police-trained private detectives become involved in a whirlwind of danger when they invest-igate the death of a woman stock car racer in the premiere episode of the new detective-drama series, Charlie's Angels. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and-Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant. In Hellride, Sabrina becomes a race driver while Kelly, Jill and Bosley assume unusual disguises to learn why a pretty woman driver lost control of her car and died in a flaming wreck.

programme.title: The Mexican Connection
programme.desc: Jill, Kelly and Sabrina find themselves in the middle of a syndicate heroin war as The Mexican Connection airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. Charlie assigns the girls to find the saboteurs of a charter plane carrying cache of heroin. They travel south of the border to Mexico; their mission known only to the lone-surviving pilot of the ill-fated flight. Before they can sake their false identities credible, Charlie's Angels find themselves caught be-tween two warring heroin dealers. Finally, they are able to maneuver one of the drug kingpins into a federal police trap -- only to discover that the other one was working with them all along, under a false identity of his own! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smyth star as the Angels Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Night of the Strangler
programme.desc: Kelly is a dead-ringer for a famous (murdered) photographer's model Night of the Strangler on Charlie's Angels. A series of rag doll stranglings brings Charlie's Angels (Kelly, Jill and Sabrina) into the case. Charlie counts on Kelly's resemblance to the first murdered girl to attract the killer. The wife of a well-known fashion designer is the next victim. Narrowing the possibilities, Charlie's Angels date the three most suspect men -- knowing full well one of them is a killer of great ingenuity and imagination. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels in Chains
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as Angels in Chains airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a kangaroo court to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an early release and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Target: Angels
programme.desc: Multiple attempts to kill Kelly, Jill and Sabrina force them to flee to the safety of Charlie's mansion in Target Angels on the new series Charlie's Angels. In separate incidents, an unknown assassin tries to kill Angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina. The pressure intensifies, forcing the girls to take to the only sure safety they know the compound where Charlie lives. Their anticipation at the prospect of seeing Charlie for the first time dims when they suddenly realize they have led the killers to their real target - Charlie! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Killing Kind
programme.desc: Charlie calls angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina together and tells them of the murder of the daughter of an old friend -- a young investigative reporter. In their quest to solve the killing, the three (Jill posing as a magazine photographer, Sabrina as a tennis instructor and Kelly as a guest) penetrate an exclusive hotel-resort. They soon learn that the owner, an underworld figure who, after turn-ing state's evidence and getting a new identity as part of the government's witness relocation program, has built a new criminal empire for himself. Their second discovery is that he intends to kill them. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.desc: Charlie's Angels, three bright, beautiful, athletic and police-trained private detectives become involved in a whirlwind of danger when they invest-igate the death of a woman stock car racer in the premiere episode of the new detective-drama series, Charlie's Angels. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and-Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant. In Hellride, Sabrina becomes a race driver while Kelly, Jill and Bosley assume unusual disguises to learn why a pretty woman driver lost control of her car and died in a flaming wreck.

programme.title: The Mexican Connection
programme.desc: Jill, Kelly and Sabrina find themselves in the middle of a syndicate heroin war as The Mexican Connection airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. Charlie assigns the girls to find the saboteurs of a charter plane carrying cache of heroin. They travel south of the border to Mexico; their mission known only to the lone-surviving pilot of the ill-fated flight. Before they can sake their false identities credible, Charlie's Angels find themselves caught be-tween two warring heroin dealers. Finally, they are able to maneuver one of the drug kingpins into a federal police trap -- only to discover that the other one was working with them all along, under a false identity of his own! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smyth star as the Angels Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Night of the Strangler
programme.desc: Kelly is a dead-ringer for a famous (murdered) photographer's model Night of the Strangler on Charlie's Angels. A series of rag doll stranglings brings Charlie's Angels (Kelly, Jill and Sabrina) into the case. Charlie counts on Kelly's resemblance to the first murdered girl to attract the killer. The wife of a well-known fashion designer is the next victim. Narrowing the possibilities, Charlie's Angels date the three most suspect men -- knowing full well one of them is a killer of great ingenuity and imagination. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels in Chains
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as Angels in Chains airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a kangaroo court to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an early release and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Target: Angels
programme.desc: Multiple attempts to kill Kelly, Jill and Sabrina force them to flee to the safety of Charlie's mansion in Target Angels on the new series Charlie's Angels. The pressure intensifies, forcing the girls to take to the only sure safety they know the compound where Charlie lives. Their anticipation at the prospect of seeing Charlie for the first time dims when they suddenly realize they have led the killers to their real target - Charlie! programme.title: Bullseye

programme.title: Consenting Adults
programme.desc: A computer dating service, fronting for prostitutes and their robber accomplices, starts an underworld war by stealing hot diamonds from a syndicate courier in The Consenting Adults on Charlie's Angels. A prostitute supplied by a computer dating service keeps an antique dealer preoccupied while his store is burglarized of priceless art objects. One of the stolen items is a ceramic frog, stuffed with smuggled diamonds -- belonging to a ruthless crime syndicate boss. Thinking he is lying about the thefts, the enraged kingpin kidnaps the antique dealers and Charlie's Angels enter the case. Jill infiltrates the dating service posing as a hooker but finds that the prostitute involved in the burglary has led the crime boss to the diamonds. In a last ditch effort to gain evidence, Angels Sabrina and Jill disguise themselves as veterinarians and steal the syndicate chieftain's championship racehorse. The chieftain agrees to meet the Angels in a park and turn over the diamonds in exchange for his horse. In the exciting climax, Angel Jill must make a getaway with the evidence on her skateboard -- chased by a syndicate hit man Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Seance
programme.desc: Rich widows and widowers are hypnotized into thinking their deceased spouses still manage their business affairs from the 'other side' as The Seance airs on Charlie's Angels. A spirited dowager, pressured by insurance investigators about the repeated disappearances of her jewelry, hires Charlie's Angels to solve the mystery. The girls get their first clue when the daffy old lady tells them that her dead husband manages her business affairs from the grave through a medium named Madame Dorian. Kelly assumes the identity of a rich Texas widow; Jill becomes her friend from the 'Lone Star' state and Bosley, their French chauffeur. Unbeknownst to the others, Madame Dorian's male assistant hypnotizes Kelly as he had done with previous widows -- to get financial information from her. During the trance, she reveals her true identity as a private investigator. Realizing that the con game has been uncovered, he programs Kelly to perceive Jill as a childhood bogeyperson, so he can attempt a getaway. The hypnotized Kelly helps in his escape by keeping Charlie's team busy trying to stop her from killing Jill. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels on Wheels
programme.desc: Jill becomes the hated star of a roller derby team when she goes undercover to investigate the mysterious death of a beautiful skater as Death on Wheels airs (day/date/time) on Channel 's Charlie's Angels. Skating champ Karen Jason is killed after being forced over the guardrail and into the audience during a rough and tumble race. Charlie's client believes Karen was murdered, despite the police report stating that the death was accidental. In search of clues, Sabrina poses as a state insurance investigator, Kelly as a pushy writer for a national magazine and Jill as a member of the roller derby team. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angel Trap
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels are summoned to try and stop an assassin intent on killing the members of an old French Underground team in Angel Trap on Charlie's Angels. Fernando Lamas guest stars as Jericho, a paradoxically gentle man with a record of assassination dating back to the days of the World War II French Underground. He becomes the prime suspect when a former member of his old liberationist team is killed. From one of Jericho's ex-girlfriends, Charlie's Angels learn chat he intends to eliminate all of the members of his old French Underground team. In an attempt to capture Jericho before he can carry out his plans, Sabrina poses as the girlfriend of Kamden, the' next likely victim of the team, and Jill sets up an accidental meeting with Jericho. Jill soon finds it difficult to keep her mind on the job as she becomes emotionally involved with the romantic killer. She and Sabrina guess that the probable time and place of Jericho's next move will be in the city park. There, Kelly and an army of police await the inevitable. Jericho arrives in their midst, smiling confidently, carrying his pet kitten. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Big Tap Out
programme.desc: Sabrina, Jill and Kelly con a compulsive gambler out of his money in order to trap him in his usual burglary method of replenishing his gambling stakes in The Big Tap Out, on Charlie's Angels. When notorious gambler-thief, Roy David is suspected of burglarizing a securities company of $40,000 to replenish his gambling money, Charlie's Angels are called into the case to obtain the necessary evidence to convict him of the crime. Sabrina and Bosley dupe the gambler into betting nearly half of the loot on a losing horse at the race track. Jill then takes over the scheme at the gambling tables to cheat him out of his remaining money. With David penniless and in desperate need of renewed gambling stakes, the Angels make it easy for him to follow his usual burglary pattern. In front of startled eyes, they carefully, stage a hit-and-run accident in which Jill is apparently killed with detailed floor plans and safe combinations to the casino in her possession. David, of course, steals the plans and immediately sets up a burglary. When David tries to make his getaway from the casino with the stolen money, Kelly stops his escape by ramming her car into the back of his, thereby causing a great commotion into which the police are summoned. On the scene, police discover the cache of stolen money inside David's car, and his gambling days are over. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.
